sources.evidence: 乳胶、记忆慢回弹和生物基枕供应分类
荞麦枕商品与枕芯供货商
乳胶、记忆棉、凝胶枕系列
荞麦与羽丝绒双面复合枕

limits: 找源头官网未返回可读取商品内容；91和DSS采用搜索可检索商品信息。分类代表可选择目标结构，不证明用户SKU成分、含量、认证或功能。

variants.name: 纤维枕（羽丝绒）
variants.hint: 柔软蓬松 · 圆润边角
variants.zh: 纤维填充枕，柔软矩形鼓包，中心饱满、边缘渐薄、底部受压；羽丝绒是纤维款名称，不画羽毛
variants.en: FIBER-FILLED pillow: soft rectangular loft, full center, tapered rounded edges and gravity-compressed base; imitation-down fiber is NOT feathers

variants.name: 大豆纤维枕
variants.hint: 柔和蓬松 · 连续壳布
variants.zh: 大豆纤维类填充枕，柔和矩形轮廓与适中蓬松，完整壳布；不生成黄豆颗粒或额外植物装饰
variants.en: SOY-FIBER blend style: moderately lofted soft rectangular shell; no visible soybeans or botanical decorations

variants.name: 羽绒 / 羽毛枕
variants.hint: 轻盈软塌 · 自然承托
variants.zh: 羽绒或羽毛类填充枕，轻盈柔软、松弛下陷、圆润薄边，完整防绒壳布；不露羽毛，不虚构绒含量或分仓
variants.en: DOWN/FEATHER-filled style: soft yielding loft and rounded thin edges within an intact shell; no escaping feathers, invented down percentage or internal chambers

variants.name: 乳胶枕
variants.hint: 一体定型 · 高低波浪轮廓
variants.zh: 乳胶一体定型高低波浪枕，两条不同高度的长边与中间浅凹，保持弹性实芯轮廓，外罩贴合；孔洞仅在用户提供裸芯参考时呈现
variants.en: LATEX molded contour: unequal-height long ridges and a shallow central cradle; cohesive elastic core, close-fitting cover, not a loose puff; holes only when an explicit bare-core reference confirms them

variants.name: 记忆棉枕
variants.hint: 慢回弹款 · 连续曲面
variants.zh: 记忆棉一体高低波浪枕，柔和连续曲面、清楚高低边和中间凹槽，受压局部下陷；不画散棉鼓包或乳胶孔洞
variants.en: MEMORY-FOAM molded contour: continuous curved surface, high/low long edges and central cradle, local compression; no loose fiber puff or invented latex perforations

variants.name: 凝胶复合枕
variants.hint: 复合定型 · 完整外罩
variants.zh: 凝胶复合定型枕，记忆棉式连续曲面与完整贴合外罩；凝胶层藏于壳内，不自行加蓝色凝胶、液体或透明剖面
variants.en: GEL-COMPOSITE contour pillow with cohesive foam geometry and intact fitted cover; gel is internal, no invented blue panel, liquid or transparent cutaway

variants.name: 荞麦枕
variants.hint: 低蓬松 · 稳定颗粒承托
variants.zh: 荞麦壳填充枕，偏低矩形、紧实稳固而非羽绒鼓包，真实微小不均匀起伏，完整壳布不露颗粒
variants.en: BUCKWHEAT-HULL filled pillow: low stable rectangular volume, subtle granular settling under intact cloth, not a fluffy down puff; no exposed hulls

variants.name: 决明子枕
variants.hint: 颗粒填充款 · 克制起伏
variants.zh: 决明子颗粒类枕，低到中等蓬松、紧实矩形，壳布完整且局部轻微颗粒起伏；不臆造颗粒比例、分区或药用效果
variants.en: CASSIA-SEED style pillow: low-to-medium firm rectangular volume, slight granular settling beneath intact cloth; no invented seed ratio, partitions or medical claims

variants.name: 可调节复合枕
variants.hint: 复合填充 · 高度按参考
variants.zh: 可调节复合填充枕，默认完整适中蓬松矩形；多芯、可拆层和调节开口仅依明确产品参考，不自动加拉链、剖切或爆炸图
variants.en: ADJUSTABLE COMPOSITE pillow: intact moderately lofted rectangle by default; multiple cores, removable layers and adjustment closures ONLY when explicitly confirmed; no invented zipper, cutaway or exploded view
